description: This Java source file defines the AndroidValueResourcesIndex class, which extends FileBasedIndexExtension to index Android resource entries in XML files, specifically resource tags with attributes like 'name' and 'type'. It includes methods for parsing XML resource files, creating resource entries, and externalizing index data.

classes.name: AndroidValueResourcesIndex
classes.description: A class extending FileBasedIndexExtension to index Android resource entries in XML files, providing methods for indexing, serialization, and resource entry creation.

classes.name: AndroidValueResourcesIndex.MyResourceInfo
classes.description: A nested class representing resource information with resource entry and offset, used as index value.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps file content to resource entries if the file is a relevant XML resource file.

methods.name: isSimilarFile
methods.description: Checks if the file content resembles an Android resource XML file with 'resources' root tag.

methods.name: processResourceEntry
methods.description: Creates a resource info object and adds it to the result map, indexing by resource type and name.

methods.name: addEntryToMap
methods.description: Adds resource info to a set in the result map under a specific key.

methods.name: createTypeMarkerKey
methods.description: Creates a resource entry used as a marker for resource type.

methods.name: createTypeNameMarkerKey
methods.description: Creates a resource entry used as a marker for resource type and name.

methods.name: normalizeDelimiters
methods.description: Replaces non-letter/digit characters in a string with underscores.
